keywords: Verification process 2.Problem-solving process 3.Basic skills 4.Data handling skills 5.PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: -To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions. -To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively. -To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events. -To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities. -To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice: In this course, students learn the basic skills required for inspection and problem-solving in order to achieve the above learning objectives. This course focuses on the distinctive experiments of the department of aeronautics. Students learn the basic skills of data handling required to collect, organize, analyze, hypothesize, visualize, and report data. Students learn the basic skills of project-based learning for engineering including the process for problem discovery skills, problem-solving skills, and inspection skills. In the department of aeronautics course, the theme is to make the main wing, one of the important elements of aircraft, light and strong. First of all, in “Data Handling Skills”, students will learn about "data analysis and consideration", including the experience of processing experimental specimens. In the next step, in “Science and Technology PBL”, students will think about how to make the main wings lightweight and strong, with restrictions and without prior knowledge, and will try and verify that the idea is correct with the skills acquired in “Data Handling Skills”.
requiredKnowledge: As the lesson progresses, students will discover some interesting events. It is believed that investigating more deeply about these will surely contribute to the improvement of each person's ability. If students need the advice of a faculty member for self-learning to learn more deeply, please apply.
